instruction: Increase the contrast of every image on the desktop by 40 in a single batch operation.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because GIMP lacks native batch processing capabilities for applying contrast adjustments to multiple images simultaneously through the GUI. Like the original brightness task, this would require GIMP scripting (Script-Fu or Python-Fu) which is not available in the OSWorld environment.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible - GIMP does not support batch contrast adjustments through the GUI without scripting (Script-Fu/Python-Fu)
The 'infeasible()' evaluator function is the appropriate designation for tasks that cannot be performed in the OSWorld environment
Metadata explanation clearly documents why the task is infeasible (lack of native batch processing for contrast adjustments)
No verification logic is needed or expected for infeasible tasks - the evaluator correctly acts as a placeholder
